answer.reason: The marked verses state events of the heavenly temple: it was opened, the ark was seen, angels came out, and it was filled with smoke.

clauses.english: was opened in heaven, and the ark of his testament was seen in it
clauses.quote: the temple of God was opened in heaven

clauses.english: was opened, and the seven angels with the seven plagues came out of it
clauses.quote: the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues

clauses.english: was filled with smoke from the glory of God, so that no man could enter
clauses.quote: the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God

doubts: REV 14:17 names the temple in heaven, but only as where an angel with a sickle came from; left out as a minor detail.
The Hebrews verses speak of the true tabernacle but are context, not marked, and are not used.
